articles.title: Crypto tax bills a work-in-progress as U.S. House lawmakers pose concerns
articles.snippet: The effort to push several tax bills is meant to be bipartisan, but the parties may not be comfortable with all details of the seven bills weighed by the panel.

articles.title: Securitize CEO says tokenized stocks could unlock a $5 trillion crypto market
articles.snippet: At a panel at ETHConf, Carlos Domingo argued that bringing stocks and exchange-traded funds onchain could unlock a market far larger than today's roughly $30 billion tokenized asset sector.

articles.title: Onchain gambling keeps rolling with $14B quarter despite crypto slump: TRM Labs
articles.snippet: TRM Labs said onchain gambling reached $51 billion in 2025, with repeat users and stablecoin flows helping the sector remain resilient during a broader crypto market pullback.

articles.title: Tether, Nvidia and Amazon Back Humanoid Robotics Firm NEURA in $1.4 Billion Funding Round
articles.snippet: Stablecoin giant Tether led a massive Series C round for German robotics firm NEURA, which will embed crypto payment tools and edge AI.

articles.title: Delaware Advances Bill to Ban ‘Predatory’ Bitcoin ATMs
articles.snippet: Lawmakers have advanced legislation that would ban all cryptocurrency kiosks statewide, with physical removal mandated within 90 days.
